generated.description: A pirate ship modeled on the Queen Anne's Revenge from Pirates of the Caribbean, built mainly from oak planks, oak logs, and oak fences, with black and red wool accents and a water-filled hull. It stands about 35 blocks wide, 89 high, and 103 deep, and is built on water, with a few chests and a trapdoor-and-button detail inside.
